description: Counts of the active satellites: total, by owner (country or organisation, e.g. US, PRC, CIS, ESA), by operator (SpaceX, OneWeb, Amazon Kuiper…), by CelesTrak group (constellations, navigation, weather…), by orbit regime (LEO, MEO, GEO, HEO), object type, launch year, recent launches and low-orbit altitude bands. owner, operator or group narrow a list to matching entries (code or name).

group.description: Narrow the group list to this CelesTrak group, e.g. "starlink", "gps-ops", "weather".

lang.description: Language of names and texts (default en).

operator.description: Narrow the operator list to this operator, e.g. "SpaceX", "OneWeb".

owner.description: Narrow the owner list to this SATCAT owner code or name, e.g. "US", "PRC", "ESA".

name: perigee_stats
title: Satellite statistics
